description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Cylinder Head Plug Kit
Provides all Necessary Plugs for the 1.6L / 16 Valve Engine
INCLUDES Guide Pins!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Guide Pins (Head to Block)
Qty 5 – Insert Plugs
Qty 1 – Screw-in Plug
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1993 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1993 – 1998 All Models
